about: A-10 v3 emotion test set (D-8.3). Hand-written intended emotion per line ('gold director'), so the voice model is the only variable. Lines are original; characters are the sample script's designed voices. ser = the IEMOCAP class an emotion recogniser should hear (neutral / angry / happy / sad), null when the emotion has no IEMOCAP class.

lines.text: I won. I actually won! Mira, look at the numbers, every single one!
It's gone. All of it. I put everything on one number and it's gone.
It's an expensive camera in a haunted chapel. Totally fine. Absolutely nothing to worry about.
He waited fifty years. Fifty years, and nobody even came to look for him.
You brought them here? In this rain? To this door? After everything I told you!
The water's coming up. Fast. Mira, we have to go, now!
Don't move. Something is down there, at the bottom of the steps.
Your grandmother kept this for me. Now you keep it.
A lantern, Grandfather? Of course it's a lantern. It was always going to be a lantern.
This survey is from nineteen sixty-two. It shows a chapel here, and a passage under it.
They said a team. I see one wet woman with a paper map.
Rafi? Is that... is that him? Oh no. Oh no, no.
